_comment: Maximum release size in bytes per artifact (file name without extension), the same budget on every platform. The gate fails when one is exceeded or missing. wheelhouse and wheelhouse-daemon were measured with the daemon in WH-3 at 2,702,656 bytes (macOS arm64) and 3,219,968 bytes (Windows x86_64), the larger of which + ~10% is the budget. The spikes are still placeholders.
